Nubes et caligo in circuitu ejus;
Clouds and mist are all around him.
justitia et judicium correctio sedis ejus.
Justice and judgment are corrections from his throne.
et inflammabit in circuitu inimicos ejus.
and it will enflame his enemies all around.
His lightnings have enlightened the whole world.
Montes sicut cera fluxerunt a facie Domini;
The mountains flowed like wax before the face of the Lord,
before the face of the Lord of all the earth.
et viderunt omnes populi gloriam ejus.
and all peoples saw his glory.
May all those who adore graven images be confounded,
et qui gloriantur in simulacris suis.
along with those who glory in their false images.
All you his Angels: Adore him.
et exsultaverunt filiæ Judæ propter judicia tua,
And the daughters of Judah exulted because of your judgments,
Quoniam tu Dominus altissimus super omnem terram;
For you are the Most High Lord over all the earth.
nimis exaltatus es super omnes deos.
You are greatly exalted above all gods.
The Lord watches over the souls of his holy ones.
He will free them from the hand of the sinner.
The light has risen for the just,
and joy for the upright of heart.
and confess to the memory of his sanctuary.
